title: Tipper Replacement - Installation (7.3.22.2)
summary: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate, reconnect conduit/power/air/Ethernet to the column and control box, remount optional components if needed, reinstall side panels if necessary, and restart the operator station.
when_to_use: Use when a tipper has been removed and the area is prepared, and you need to install the replacement tipper and reconnect conduit/power/air/Ethernet so the operator station can be restarted.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical installation steps (tipper mounting, reconnections, side panel reinstallation) and restart the operator station.
safety_notes: PPE required by the procedure: safety glasses and gloves.
access_or_tools_needed: Tools needed: not specified in this installation section

system_preconditions: The tipper has already been removed and the area is prepared (installation follows removal).
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (referenced by the manual in the removal section): "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2.
Gripper Replacement (referenced by the manual): "Gripper Replacement" on page 97.
Starting The Operator Station (referenced by the manual): "Starting The Operator Station" on page 1.

steps.title: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate
steps.purpose: Physically mount the replacement tipper so the station can be reassembled and restarted.
steps.instruction: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate.
steps.expected_result: The new tipper is installed on the existing sub-plate.
steps.healthy_condition: The replacement tipper is seated/mounted on the existing sub-plate (no missing mounting step from the installation sequence).
steps.failure_condition: The tipper is not mounted on the existing sub-plate or is left partially installed.

actions.label: Mount tipper on sub-plate
actions.exact_action: Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.22.2: INSTALLATION 1. Install the new tipper onto the existing sub-plate.

steps.title: Reconnect conduit, power, air, and Ethernet to the column and control box
steps.purpose: Restore the tipper’s required connections so the operator station can be restarted.
steps.instruction: Connect the conduit, power, air, and Ethernet to the column and control box.
steps.expected_result: Conduit/power/air/Ethernet are connected to the column and control box.
steps.healthy_condition: All required connection types (conduit, power, air, Ethernet) are reconnected to the specified locations (column and control box).
steps.failure_condition: Any of the required connection types are not connected to the column/control box (e.g., Ethernet not reconnected).

actions.label: Reconnect required utilities
actions.exact_action: Connect the conduit, power, air, and Ethernet to the column and control Box.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.22.2: INSTALLATION 2. Connect the conduit, power, air, and Ethernet to the column and control Box.

steps.title: Mount the gripper, if necessary
steps.purpose: Reinstall optional components required for correct station operation after tipper replacement.
steps.instruction: Mount the gripper, if necessary (see "Gripper Replacement" on page 97).
steps.expected_result: If the gripper was removed or is not currently mounted, it is mounted.
steps.healthy_condition: Gripper is mounted when it is necessary for the station configuration after tipper replacement.
steps.failure_condition: Gripper remains unmounted when it should be mounted for the station configuration.

actions.label: Re-mount gripper
actions.exact_action: Mount the gripper, if necessary (see "Gripper Replacement" on page 97).

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.22.2: INSTALLATION 3. Mount the gripper, if necessary (see "Gripper Replacement" on page 97).

steps.title: Reinstall top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary
steps.purpose: Restore the station’s side panel covers after installation work.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.
steps.expected_result: Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled as needed.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panels are reinstalled when they were removed or are not currently in place.
steps.failure_condition: Side panels remain removed when they should be reinstalled after installation.

actions.label: Reinstall side panels
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.22.2: INSTALLATION 4. Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

steps.title: Re-start the operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the operator station back online after the tipper installation and reconnections.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 1).
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station restart completes successfully (station is back in service per the manual’s start guidance).
steps.failure_condition: Operator station cannot be restarted after installation.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 1).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station cannot be restarted after installation, stop and escalate per the manual’s operator station start guidance ("Starting The Operator Station" on page 1).

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.22.2: INSTALLATION 5. Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 1).

success_criteria: New tipper is installed on the existing sub-plate.
Conduit/power/air/Ethernet are connected to the column and control box.
Any necessary gripper and side panels are reinstalled.
healthy_conditions: Operator station restart completes successfully after installation.
failure_conditions: Operator station cannot be restarted after installation.
escalation_guidance: If the operator station cannot be restarted after installation, stop and escalate per the manual’s operator station start guidance ("Starting The Operator Station" on page 1).
